sentences.text: The product note’s “no foreclosure charge” position matches the RBI direction for individual borrowers on floating rate loans for non-business purposes, but that RBI text is limited to existing floating rate term loans sanctioned before 31 December 2025.
The available facts show the borrower is an individual with a floating-rate, non-business loan, but they do not show the sanction date needed to confirm the RBI condition.
The bank’s own loan agreement also states a 3% pre-payment charge on foreclosure or pre-payment, so the product note is not consistent with that agreement text.
